In college, I got in trouble for an experiment I did for a sociology class.

I printed cards with the following messages: "1st most attractive", "2nd most attractive", "3rd most attractive" etc. I sealed the cards in blank white envelopes with colored dots on top to remind me which card was in each one. Then I would approach groups of girls walking together, and gave each member of the group a different envelope. In other words, I was giving them their rating in a sealed envelope.

I would then retreat, and a friend of mine standing nearby would take notes on how they reacted when they opened the envelopes. The results were interesting - the most common reaction was that the lowest rated and highest rated members of the group ended up fighting (verbally, not physically).

We intended to repeat the experiment with my partner (a girl) giving cards to guys, but someone reported us on the first day and we had to stop.
